packageRules.description: Strip the leading 'v' from Apktool GitHub release tags. No automerge: upstream ships no checksums, so APKTOOL_SHA256 in the Dockerfile must be updated by hand before the PR can build
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ `APKTOOL_SHA256` in the Dockerfile must be updated manually for this version — upstream publishes no checksums, so the build fails checksum verification until the hash is refreshed. See DEVELOPMENT.md → 'Updating Apktool'.

packageRules.description: Temurin 21 apk pin: versions come from the Artifactory directory listing; extractVersion filters the hrefs down to temurin-21-jre-*.apk
Automatically merge minor and patch updates for Temurin (quarterly CPU patches; old pins stay installable in the Adoptium index, so a bad automerge is trivially revertible)
